data.gender_notes: Kavindraan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Kavindraan is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Kavi' meaning sage or poet, and 'Indra' meaning the lord of the universe. This name signifies a wise and powerful individual who commands respect and authority. The name Kavindraan carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kavindraan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes wisdom, power, and divine authority
